description: This file defines types, functions, and a store implementation for managing Microsoft Teams polls, including creating polls, recording votes, and handling poll data persistence.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a record object.

methods.name: normalizeChoiceValue
methods.description: Normalizes a choice value to a string or null.

methods.name: extractSelections
methods.description: Extracts an array of selection strings from various input formats.

methods.name: readNestedValue
methods.description: Reads a nested value from an object given a path of keys.

methods.name: readNestedString
methods.description: Reads a nested string value from an object given a path of keys.

methods.name: extractMSTeamsPollVote
methods.description: Extracts a poll vote object from an activity input.

methods.name: buildMSTeamsPollCard
methods.description: Builds an adaptive card for a poll with specified parameters.

methods.name: parseTimestamp
methods.description: Parses a timestamp string into a number, or returns null.

methods.name: pruneExpired
methods.description: Removes expired polls based on TTL.

methods.name: pruneToLimit
methods.description: Limits the number of polls stored to MAX_POLLS.

methods.name: normalizeMSTeamsPollSelections
methods.description: Normalizes and limits poll selections based on poll constraints.

methods.name: createMSTeamsPollStoreFs
methods.description: Creates a file-based store for managing polls, including create, get, and vote recording functions.
